title: Pulse in a compliant tube
line: A transient fluid-structure FEA study of a pressure pulse traveling along a silicone tube full of water.
description: A 4 ms surge of inflow enters a silicone tube (10 mm bore, 1 mm wall, 200 mm long) full of water; fluid and wall are solved together. The study samples the pressure 50 mm and 150 mm from the inlet; the Moens-Korteweg wave speed, 15 to 17 m/s, sets the 6 to 7 ms travel time between them.
thumbnailAlt: Pressure pulse traveling along a compliant silicone tube, solved in RunMat
